project_info.target_audience: Parents in Bhojpur, Bihar browsing primarily on Android mobile devices with moderate bandwidth, seeking affordable, high-quality, trustworthy primary education.

design_archetype.name: Swiss-Educational Precision & Warm Trust
design_archetype.description: Combines high-trust Swiss grid clarity with warm, approachable Indian educational storytelling. Avoids generic corporate templates or ultra-luxury elite vibes. Feels authentic, academically rigorous, and deeply welcoming for parents in Bihar.

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#123D62]

logo_and_brand_assets.svg_logo_mark: Custom crafted vector badge featuring a open book foundation, rising sun rays of enlightenment, and a stylized home roof structure in #0756A5 and #123D62 with golden gradient spark.
logo_and_brand_assets.favicon: SVG roof + open book favicon rendered in crisp vector format.
logo_and_brand_assets.header_style: Sticky header with glassmorphism backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 border-b border-[#E2E8F0] z-50
logo_and_brand_assets.announcement_bar: Top banner with gradient bg-[#123D62] text-white text-xs sm:text-sm py-2 px-4 flex justify-between items-center

motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: Lenis smooth scroll engine initialized globally
motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line stagger headline reveal with Framer Motion (initial hidden, animated upwards with easeOut cubic bezier)
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveal: Framer Motion threshold-triggered scroll reveal (fade up 24px, spring 0.4s)
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Slow editorial text ticker (react-fast-marquee or CSS keyframes) featuring core pillars: English Fluency • Computer Literacy • Math Mastery • Character Values • Affordable Excellence
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Subtle scale lift (hover: -translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300), active button press effect
motion_and_interactions.reduced_motion: Respects prefers-reduced-motion media query by falling back to static opacities

layout_and_spacing.card_padding: p-6 sm:p-8 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md bg-white transition-all

sections: 2. Signature Hero (Masked line reveal, badge, dual CTAs, stats ticker, classroom visual)
3. Four Philosophy Cards (Academic Rigor, English Voice, Tech Literacy, Moral Foundation)
4. Editorial Ribbon Marquee (Drifting core value phrases)
5. Grade Cards (Classes 1 to 5 breakdown with key learning outcomes & interactive tabs)
6. English & Communication Showcase (Phonics, Public speaking, Daily English drills)
7. Computer Education Spotlight (Hands-on labs, Coding basics, Digital safety)
8. Practical & Experiential Learning (STEM kits, Math lab, Science experiments)
9. Sports & Physical Well-being (Outdoor games, Agility, Yoga, Teamwork)
10. Curated Learning Resources & Library (Physical books, Activity worksheets)
11. Continuous Assessment & Progress Tracking (No stress tests, regular parent reports)
12. Values & Character Building (Ethics, Respect, Discipline, Community)
13. Parent Partnership & Open Door Policy (Regular PTMs, WhatsApp updates, Progress app)
14. Affordability & Transparent Fee Promise (No hidden charges, maximum value for Bihar families)
16. Final High-Conversion Admission CTA Banner (Direct Enquiry Form trigger & WhatsApp contact)
Categories: Admissions, Academics, Fees, Transport, Safety

interactive_features.admission_modal: Fast opening Dialog modal triggered by 'Admission Enquiry' CTA on top header, hero section, and sticky bottom mobile bar
interactive_features.whatsapp_float: Fixed bottom-right WhatsApp quick chat button linking directly to school admission helpline
interactive_features.mobile_sticky_cta: Fixed bottom CTA bar on mobile viewports for instant 1-tap admission enquiry
interactive_features.grade_tabs: Interactive class filter tabs (Class 1, Class 2, Class 3, Class 4, Class 5) with custom curriculum highlights
interactive_features.faq_accordion: Shadcn Accordion component for instant expandable FAQs with category filters
interactive_features.form_validation: Form validation for student name, parent phone number (10-digit Indian standard), grade selection, and district location.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements MUST include explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='nav-admission-btn', data-testid='enquiry-form-submit', data-testid='whatsapp-floating-btn')
testing_and_accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44px x 44px tap targets for mobile convenience
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_ratio: Text meets APCA / WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1 contrast against white (#FFFFFF) and light gray (#F3F6FA) backgrounds.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the 14-page route setup using React Router in JavaScript (.js/.jsx files).
Use Lenis smooth scrolling and Framer Motion for scroll triggers and hero line reveal animations.
Strictly adhere to the brand color palette (#0756A5 primary blue, #123D62 deep navy, #FFFFFF background, #F3F6FA light grey alternate).
Include data-testid attributes on ALL buttons, inputs, links, forms, and cards.
Implement the custom SVG logo mark for The Study Home School prominently in the header and footer.
Ensure 100% responsive performance across mobile (Android emphasis), tablet, and desktop viewports.
Use Sonner for toast notifications when user submits admission enquiry or contact forms.
